title: Cancellation and hold
summary: Host abort retains custody until the interrupted case records starting_state_restore: restored=true for its baseline, or a no-restore receipt for as_is. Removed missions finish through walk-end. Cleanup finish and deliberate manual QA_HOST release end custody; unproven restoration records reset_owed for the case baseline, defaulting to fresh-host. The next holder resets before any case or mission, including as_is. Failed recovery records machine_needs_repair and the reset command in evidence and steering. A later successful reset clears debt. Source tests are not deployed proof. After a terminal deployment run, the original session may abort or finish walk-end; release reasons name run status. Settled executions report their state, while ordinary writes require an active stage. Ordinary failed restores and terminal captures missing restore proof also record debt before custody ends. Intentional as_is no-restore receipts and successful intermediate chain captures retain their declared semantics. A live steering seat stops another session's live execution through the same stop request instead of settling it: the receipt's stop_request names the owner session, and the owner's runner stops at its next case check-in or host heartbeat, cleans up and settles under steering-stop-requested naming the requesting session. Without a seat the abort refuses with qa_execution_stop_requires_steering and names the steering path.
